test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The statement below has been given with bracketed text, Select the option with the correct idiom for the bracketed text.**

Don't start to think we've (won this game certainly), gentlemen.

options.text: got this game in the bag

solution: The correct answer is **"got this game in the bag."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Got this game in the bag"** is an idiom that means to have already won or achieved victory. (पहले ही जीत लिया हो या जीत हासिल कर ली हो) • **Example**: *The **game was in the bag**__ when the team scored their third goal. * • It is used to caution against overconfidence or premature celebration. • The phrase **"in the bag"** refers to something that is already secured or guaranteed. (कुछ ऐसा जो पहले से ही सुरक्षित या गारंटीशुदा हो) • The speaker is warning the others not to assume they have won the game before it is officially over. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "swallowed the bitter truth"**, means to accept an unpleasant reality or fact. (किसी अप्रिय वास्तविकता या तथ्य को स्वीकार करना) • **Option 2, "held our horses"**, is another idiom that means to wait or be patient. (प्रतीक्षा करना या धैर्य रखना) • **Option 3, "have skin in the game"**, is a phrase that means to have a personal stake or investment in a situation. (किसी स्थिति में व्यक्तिगत हिस्सेदारी या निवेश करना) 1ef:Tc1c, The correct answer is **"evasive."**
